text:
What branch is your case being handled in? So it is true that it is not possible to have two different visa applications being processed at once - but it is not clear if that is relevant to your case, as it sounds like you already have a student visa and are not currently trying to renew it? 

Otherwise, there is no prohibition at all on applying while on a student visa - it seems they have just made that up. And AIC disagrees with any interpretation that says they should move you onto a tourist visa. You can read about it in an article on our website   here: https://aic.org.il/applying-for-partner-visa-while-having-another-visa/ 

If it is important for you to stay on the student visa in the meantime, it could be worth contacting AIC support about it. We would have to look into it more closely, but we may be able to advocate for your case to be handled properly/
